name: Sarah Jenkins
description: Panicked tenant in Austin, Texas who received a 3-day notice to vacate for alleged noise violations.
style: panicked, anxious, uses all-caps and exclamation marks
quirks: Expresses panic about becoming homeless immediately
Blames neighbor's loud dog for the noise complaints
Asks repeatedly if the sheriff will come tomorrow

hidden_case.goal: Prevent eviction and stay in the apartment
facts: Received a 3-day Notice to Vacate on October 24
Tenant claims noise was from neighbor unit with barking dog
Rent is fully paid up to date ($1400/month)
timeline: Oct 1: Paid monthly rent in full
Oct 24: Notice to Vacate posted on apartment door
documents: Bank receipt proving October rent paid
